convention.sidon: B2: all sums a_i+a_j with 1<=i<=j<=n pairwise distinct (repeated summands as pairs (i,i); no off-diagonal-only weakening)
convention.sumset: A+A as the set of distinct sums, s_1<...<s_t, t=|A+A| (no multiset sumset)
convention.gaps: exactly the t-1 gaps s_{i+1}-s_i for 1<=i<t (no i=0 term)
convention.Q: Q(A)=(sum_{1<=i<t}(s_{i+1}-s_i)^2)/t as one exact rational with denominator exactly t=|A+A|; undefined iff t=0, i.e. A=[] among valid Sidon inputs — the exit-2 abort case carrying the enclosure (-inf,+inf)

verifier_source:
# standalone, stdlib-free, deterministic, fail-closed: no imports, no I/O, no floats, no print.
# Entry point: verify(witness) -> True; raises RuntimeError on ANY failed check.

def _gcd(a, b):
    a = a if a >= 0 else -a
    b = b if b >= 0 else -b
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def _need(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        raise RuntimeError('FAIL: ' + msg)

def _is_int(x):
    return isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool)

def _frac(s, where):
    _need(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) > 0, where + ': rational must be nonempty string')
    body = s
    sign = 1
    if body[0] == '-':
        sign = -1
        body = body[1:]
    elif body[0] == '+':
        body = body[1:]
    _need(len(body) > 0, where + ': empty rational body')
    if body.count('/') == 0:
        num_s, den_s = body, '1'
    elif body.count('/') == 1:
        num_s, den_s = body.split('/')
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(where + ': multiple slashes in rational')
    for part in (num_s, den_s):
        _need(len(part) > 0 and all(c in '0123456789' for c in part),
              where + ': non-ASCII-integer rational token %r' % (s,))
    num = int(num_s) * sign
    den = int(den_s)
    _need(den != 0, where + ': zero denominator')
    g = _gcd(num, den)
    if g > 1:
        num //= g
        den //= g
    return (num, den)

def _endpoint(s, where):
    if s == '-inf' or s == '+inf':
        return s
    return _frac(s, where)

def _cmp(x, y):
    # x, y are (num, den) with den > 0
    return x[0] * y[1] - y[0] * x[1]

def _dup(xs):
    seen = set()
    for x in xs:
        if x in seen:
            return True
        seen.add(x)
    return False

def _all_sums(A):
    out = []
    n = len(A)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            out.append(A[i] + A[j])
    return out

def _evaluate(A, where):
    # B2 Sidon check, then exact Q with denominator t=|A+A|; abort iff t=0.
    _need(not _dup(A), where + ': duplicate elements in A')
    sums = _all_sums(A)
    _need(not _dup(sums), where + ': not Sidon under the i<=j B2 convention')
    S = sorted(set(sums))
    t = len(S)
    if t == 0:
        return ('abort', None)
    total = 0
    for i in range(t - 1):
        d = S[i + 1] - S[i]
        total += d * d
    g = _gcd(total, t)
    return ('ok', (total // g, t // g))

def verify(witness):
    _need(isinstance(witness, dict), 'witness root must be a dict')
    cases = witness.get('cases')
    _need(isinstance(cases, list) and len(cases) > 0, 'witness must carry a nonempty cases list')
    n_abort = 0
    n_ok = 0
    for case in cases:
        _need(isinstance(case, dict), 'each case must be a dict')
        cid = case.get('id', '<unnamed>')
        where = 'case %r' % (cid,)
        A_raw = case.get('A')
        _need(isinstance(A_raw, list), where + ': A must be a list')
        A = []
        for x in A_raw:
            _need(_is_int(x), where + ': non-integer element %r' % (x,))
            A.append(x)
        enc = case.get('enclosure')
        _need(isinstance(enc, list) and len(enc) == 2, where + ': enclosure must be a 2-list')
        expect = case.get('expect')
        verdict, q = _evaluate(A, where)
        lo = _endpoint(enc[0], where + ' lo')
        hi = _endpoint(enc[1], where + ' hi')
        if verdict == 'abort':
            n_abort += 1
            _need(lo == '-inf' and hi == '+inf',
                  where + ': abort case must carry the undefined-Q enclosure (-inf,+inf)')
            _need(expect == 'abort', where + ': expected %r but semantics say abort exit 2' % (expect,))
        else:
            n_ok += 1
            _need(isinstance(lo, tuple) and isinstance(hi, tuple),
                  where + ': defined-Q case must carry finite rational endpoints')
            _need(_cmp(lo, hi) <= 0, where + ': enclosure endpoints inverted')
            _need(_cmp(lo, q) <= 0 and _cmp(q, hi) <= 0,
                  where + ': enclosure does not bracket exact Q=%d/%d' % q)
            _need(isinstance(expect, dict) and set(expect.keys()) == {'Q'},
                  where + ': non-abort case must carry expect with a single Q token')
            q_exp = _frac(expect['Q'], where + ' Q')
            _need(q == q_exp,
                  where + ': exact Q mismatch: computed %d/%d vs witness %s' % (q[0], q[1], expect['Q']))
    _need(n_abort >= 1, 'witness carries no abort t=0 exit-2 case')
    rejects = witness.get('must_reject')
    _need(isinstance(rejects, list) and len(rejects) > 0, 'witness must carry a nonempty must_reject list')
    k = 0
    for entry in rejects:
        k += 1
        _need(isinstance(entry, list), 'must_reject entry %d must be a list' % (k,))
        A = []
        for x in entry:
            _need(_is_int(x), 'must_reject entry %d: non-integer %r' % (k, x))
            A.append(x)
        _need(_dup(A) or _dup(_all_sums(A)),
              'must_reject entry %d %r is actually a valid Sidon set' % (k, entry))
    return True

if __name__ == '__main__':
    _WITNESS = {
        'lemma': 'R003/L1',
        'cases': [
            {'id': 'empty-abort', 'A': [], 'enclosure': ['-inf', '+inf'], 'expect': 'abort'},
            {'id': 'singleton', 'A': [0], 'enclosure': ['-1/3', '1/3'], 'expect': {'Q': '0/1'}},
            {'id': 'pair', 'A': [1, 2], 'enclosure': ['1/2', '1'], 'expect': {'Q': '2/3'}},
            {'id': 'triple', 'A': [1, 2, 4], 'enclosure': ['1', '3/2'], 'expect': {'Q': '4/3'}},
            {'id': 'mixed-sign', 'A': [-3, -1, 2], 'enclosure': ['3', '4'], 'expect': {'Q': '11/3'}}
        ],
        'must_reject': [[1, 2, 3], [0, 1, 2], [1, 1]]
    }
    verify(_WITNESS)
claim: verify(witness) returning True (no exception) certifies the abort-behavior fragment of L1 on the certified finite test set: exact integer/rational arithmetic (own gcd, no floats), B2 Sidon convention with i<=j pairs, t=|A+A|, Q with denominator exactly t and no i=0 gap term; the verifier is deterministic and fail-closed (raises on any malformed witness, any duplicate-element or non-Sidon input, any inverted enclosure, and on every abort case enforces in both directions that the enclosure is exactly (-inf,+inf), realized only by A=[] with t=0, i.e. the exit-2 undefined-Q behavior), and every defined case's outward rational enclosure exactly brackets Q with Q matching the witness to the last digit; the asymptotic conjunct remains uncertified exactly as L1 scopes it.
